requirements: R1: Prevent tasks from being marked as 'done' internally when their corresponding GitHub PRs are closed without being merged.

slices.title: Fix GitHub PR sync for unmerged closures
slices.jtbd: When implementing PR closure handling for this epic, I want to explicitly check the merged flag, so that internal tasks aren't marked done for discarded PRs.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a GitHub PR closed without merge event
When the system synchronizes the task status
Then the internal task is not marked as 'done' and test coverage is added for this negative case.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false-positive 'done' transitions on unmerged PR closure from >0 to 0
